Here’s a table of the **top 10 holdings of the NASDAQ-100 (NDX)** as of **June 2024**, including their **market capitalization** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratio**. The NASDAQ-100 is a market-cap-weighted index of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ stock exchange.

### **Top 10 Holdings of NASDAQ-100 (NDX) - June 2024**

| Rank | Company                | Ticker | Market Cap (USD) | P/E Ratio (Trailing 12M) | Weight in NDX* |
|------|------------------------|--------|------------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| 1    | **Microsoft**          | MSFT   | ~$3.25T          | ~38.5                     | ~9.5%          |
| 2    | **Apple**              | AAPL   | ~$3.10T          | ~30.5                     | ~9.2%          |
| 3    | **NVIDIA**             | NVDA   | ~$2.20T          | ~75.0                     | ~6.5%          |
| 4    | **Amazon**             | AMZN   | ~$1.85T          | ~55.0                     | ~5.4%          |
| 5    | **Meta (Facebook)**    | META   | ~$1.30T          | ~35.0                     | ~3.8%          |
| 6    | **Alphabet (Google) Class A** | GOOGL | ~$2.20T | ~28.0 | ~3.5% |
| 7    | **Alphabet (Google) Class C** | GOOG  | ~$2.20T | ~28.0 | ~3.4% |
| 8    | **Tesla**              | TSLA   | ~$600B           | ~45.0                     | ~1.8%          |
| 9    | **Broadcom**           | AVGO   | ~$500B           | ~70.0                     | ~1.5%          |
| 10   | **Costco**             | COST   | ~$360B           | ~50.0                     | ~1.1%          |

### **Notes:**
- **Market Cap & P/E Ratios** are approximate and can fluctuate daily (sources: Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, company filings).
- **Weight in NDX** is based on NASDAQ's official index composition (subject to rebalancing).
- **Alphabet (GOOGL & GOOG)** are separate share classes but represent the same company.
- **NVIDIA** has seen a massive surge in 2024 due to AI demand, pushing its P/E higher.
- **P/E ratios** are trailing twelve-month (TTM) unless otherwise noted. Forward P/E may differ.

### **Where to Verify Updates?**
For real-time data, check:
- [NASDAQ Official Index Composition](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/docs/NDX_Holdings.csv)
- [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/%5ENDX/holdings/)
- [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/NDX:IND)
